title: Grateful Dead Live at Golden Hall - San Diego Community Concourse on 1982-02-19
venue: Golden Hall - San Diego Community Concourse
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/88.2k) -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB/6th Row) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Fuji FeCr Tape/Dolby DB)

ai_review.summary: Excellent front‑of‑board recording captures a high‑energy San Diego show with smoking Bertha, Dire Wolf, a soaring Red Rooster solo and an unforgettable Other One.
ai_review.review: The soundboard source is crystal clear, offering superb instrument separation that puts Jerry’s guitar right up front while still preserving the band’s full mix. Musically the night erupts from tight first‑set highlights into a spacey post‑drums jam that culminates in one of the ’80s best Other Ones, with Phil’s “earthquake” riffs and an adventurous second‑set setlist.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviews are overwhelmingly positive (mostly 5 stars) praising both the performance and the pristine soundboard recording; consistency across many detailed comments yields a high confidence rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Front‑of‑board tape is crisp with excellent separation (drums, guitars, keyboards). Jerry’s guitar is prominent, vocals slightly buried but still audible; no reported dropouts or muffiness.

standout_songs: Women Smart into Johnny B. Goode
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set delivers strong, melodic highlights; second set builds a relaxed vibe with an ordinary song list but shines after Drums with a soaring space jam and the monumental Other One before closing with quirky surprises.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for slide work, Red Rooster solo, front‑of‑board guitar presence, and overall god‑like playing throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Featured prominently in the Other One with multiple “earthquake” riffs; noted as having a great time and well‑played pre‑drums.
band_member_comments.Bob: Recognized for strong rhythm guitar work on Greatest Story Ever Told.
band_member_comments.Drums: Pre‑drums described as well played; both drummers are clearly separated in the mix, and the post‑drums space jam is highlighted as a high point.
